name: Jīxiè xīnghé
summary: "Mechanical Galaxy" is a 2D sandbox adventure game. Dig, explore, and discover new mechs to gain transformation abilities. Various transformations will help you meet the challenges of many levels and bosses!

name: Jīnyōng Qúnxiá Zhuàn 5
summary:
Jinyong Qunxia Zhuan 5 is a well-known fan-made tribute to the classic wuxia RPG Jinyong Qunxia Zhuan. Developed by Wu Yagu and Play Or Away Studio, it is a sandbox wuxia action RPG (ARPG).
In the game, players can either freely create their own exclusive characters to forge a unique jianghu martial hero, or take on the roles of classic characters from Jin Yong’s original novels. From their perspectives and identities, players can roam the martial arts world, personally experience the original storylines, live entirely different jianghu lives, and explore a vast, open and free wuxia realm.
